Package com.example.sudokubeta.controller

Interface ISudokuController

All Known Implementing Classes:
SudokuController
public interface ISudokuController
Interface defining the contract for a Sudoku controller.

Implementations manage UI initialization, user help actions, board validation and synchronization between view and model.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      void initialize()
      Called by the JavaFX framework after the FXML is loaded to initialize controller state, build UI components and attach event handlers.

    • onHelp

      void onHelp()
      Provide a hint or assistance to the user (for example, fill a valid candidate).

      Implementations should update both the model and the view accordingly.

    • performValidation

      void performValidation()
      Perform full board validation: detect conflicts, update visual markers and any internal validation state.

      Should be safe to call repeatedly as user input changes.

    • updateAllCellsFromModel

      void updateAllCellsFromModel()
      Synchronize all view cells with the current state of the model.

      Typically updates text, styles and editability for each cell.

    • setPlayerName

      void setPlayerName(String playerName)
      Set the current player's name so the controller can personalize UI/messages.
      Parameters:
      playerName - the player's display name; may be null to clear
